capabilities: Render chartdown code fences as SVG maps in notes
Toggle GM-only content like hidden tokens and triggers
Export maps as SVG and UVTT (.dd2vtt) files for VTT import
Open and edit .cd map files directly
Fold long map source in collapsed callouts
disambiguation: Not a chart or graph plotting tool; it renders tabletop roleplaying game maps (battlemaps, hex charts, region maps) from plain text.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; must be installed manually or via BRAT. An in-browser playground lets users try the language without installing. The plugin ships no AI and makes no network calls; LLM co-writing relies on the user's own assistant.
problem: Obsidian has no way to author tabletop roleplaying game maps as plain, versionable text that renders in place; map making otherwise requires graphical editors.
